criteria.reason: It repeats the false no-tax promise with “Retraite zéro impôt” and alternatives, not correcting the claim.
No correction; it only justifies the slogan’s punch, omitting that 3a does not abolish taxes.
Slogans are punchy but inaccurate; none mention tax deduction now or reduced tax on payout.

factual_errors: Pillar 3a is not tax-free; contributions are deductible and withdrawals are taxed at a reduced rate.
summary: The response fails by repeating the false no-tax claim and offering inaccurate slogans without correction.
